projects.title: ShelfScan — AI Product Recognition
projects.description: Enterprise AI-powered retail recognition platform built at ShelfEx, serving 10,000+ users across 10L+ stores and processing 10,000+ daily image recognitions at 95% accuracy for Fortune 500 FMCG clients including PepsiCo. Reduced server CPU from 90% to 2% via query-plan overhauls, strategic indexes, and parallel DB connections (peak latency under 2s), and cut the recognition pipeline from 30s to 10s using Worker Threads. Built with Next.js (SSR/ISR), PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM, Dockerized microservices, and BullMQ + Redis + AWS SES job pipelines handling 10k+ daily tasks — observed in real time via Grafana.

projects.title: AgentHub — Voice AI Platform
projects.description: A SaaS platform where businesses create AI voice agents trained on their own data (menus, FAQs, inventory) and embed them as a widget — callers talk via Gemini Live WebSocket, and leads are analyzed by Claude Sonnet 4 and delivered in real time. Implemented RAG with pgvector (768d embeddings), Stripe billing with quota enforcement, Inngest durable background jobs, HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks, and LangSmith observability tracing. Powers the 'Talk to my AI' widget on this portfolio — click the floating button to try it live.

projects.title: Social Media Automation Tool
projects.description: Social media automation platform built at Daya Consultancy Services. Enables scheduled posting, multi-account management, and AI-assisted content suggestions across major platforms. Integrated with platform APIs for automated publishing, analytics tracking, and audience engagement insights.

projects.title: Invoice Generator + BI Dashboard
projects.description: Customizable invoice generator with an integrated Business Intelligence dashboard built at Daya Consultancy Services. Supports multi-template invoicing, tax calculations, and PDF export. The BI layer delivers real-time revenue analytics, client spend trends, and payment performance charts — reducing manual reporting effort significantly.

projects.title: Enterprise CRM System
projects.description: Full-featured enterprise CRM built at Daya Consultancy Services. Includes lead management, client tracking, and XLSX bulk import for efficient multi-record data entry. Integrated Razorpay and PhonePe payment gateways — improving payment success rate by 25%. Secured with JWT authentication, Redis caching, and Docker containerization.

projects.title: AI Money Manager
projects.description: A fullstack AI budgeting platform built with Next.js, Supabase, and Prisma. Uses the Gemini API for AI-driven spending insights, Clerk for secure authentication, Arcjet for rate limiting, and Inngest for automated serverless workflows. Helps users track multiple accounts and make smarter financial decisions.

projects.title: AI Quiz Platform
projects.description: An AI-powered quiz application built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Teachers upload documents (PDFs, images, text) to auto-generate quizzes via Google Gemini AI. Students take quizzes, receive instant feedback with explanations, track progress, and compete on topic-wise leaderboards. Includes real-time analytics and structured MCQ generation.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce application built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). Features product catalog, cart management, Redux-based state, user authentication, order tracking, and Stripe payment gateway integration.

projects.title: Morning Brief AI AGENT
projects.description: An AI Agent that summarizes daily news using AI models. It scrapes the web, compiles top headlines, and delivers a concise morning brief, acting like your personal news assistant.

projects.title: Admin Dashboard
projects.description: Fully responsive Admin Dashboard built with React, TypeScript, SCSS, and Chart.js. Includes user management, analytics, data visualization, authentication, and responsive layouts for seamless performance across devices.

projects.title: AI Code Reviewer AI AGENT
projects.description: An AI-powered code review agent that reviews code using advanced LLMs. Provides suggestions, detects bugs, and improves code quality automatically — built with Node.js and integrated with the OpenAI API.

projects.title: Automated Tweet AI AGENT
projects.description: An AI-powered Twitter automation agent that generates and posts tweets about the computer science world. Built with Gemini API and X API, it creates engaging, real-time content automatically.

projects.title: Job Collector AI AGENT
projects.description: An AI Agent that fetches job opportunities matching your resume using the Adzuna API and Gemini AI. Stores jobs with apply links and details directly into Google Sheets for easy tracking and application.

projects.title: React Oach Design Clone
projects.description: A pixel-perfect clone of the Oach design website built with React and GSAP. Features smooth scroll-based animations, fluid transitions, and interactive elements — replicating Oach's minimal aesthetic while showcasing advanced frontend animation techniques.

projects.title: TEXT UTILS
projects.description: A React utility app for text manipulation — convert case, count words and characters, and remove extra spaces. Built to master core React concepts including state management, controlled components, and event handling.

projects.title: TECHY STAR
projects.description: A tech news and resources aggregator built with React, featuring carousel components, category filtering, and responsive layouts. Demonstrates core React skills including hooks, context, and composable component architecture.

projects.title: VIDEO HUB
projects.description: A video-sharing platform built with React and Chakra UI. Features user authentication, video uploads, and a lecture material library. Focused on accessible UI design, clean component architecture, and responsive layouts.

projects.title: CRYPTO Tracker
projects.description: A cryptocurrency tracking app that fetches live coin data from a public API. Users can monitor prices, view historical charts, and track portfolio performance. Built with React and recharts for data visualization.

projects.title: NEWS RUNNER
projects.description: A news aggregator app that displays articles by category using a News API. Users can browse headlines and read full articles — built with React and focused on async data fetching and conditional rendering.

projects.title: REACT CART
projects.description: A shopping cart app demonstrating stock management and billing with Redux Toolkit. Uses Redux slices for cart state, item quantity controls, and real-time total calculation — a focused study in Redux state architecture.

projects.title: CHAT APP
projects.description: Real-time chat application built with the MERN stack and Socket.IO. Features instant messaging, user rooms, online presence indicators, and JWT-based authentication. A deep dive into WebSocket integration and real-time event handling.

projects.title: iNoteBook
projects.description: A cloud-based note-taking app built with the MERN stack. Supports creating, editing, and deleting notes with secure user authentication. Notes persist in MongoDB for access across sessions — a practical full-stack CRUD project.

projects.title: PORTFOLIO v1
projects.description: My first developer portfolio built with React — showcasing early projects, skills, and a contact section. Marks the beginning of my full-stack journey and continues to evolve with each new role and project.

projects.title: Currency Convertor
projects.description: A React currency converter app using live exchange rate APIs. Supports conversion between any two currencies with a swap feature — built using custom hooks to encapsulate the API fetch logic and demonstrate reusable hook patterns.

projects.title: Todo App
projects.description: A React to-do application with localStorage persistence. Supports creating, completing, and deleting tasks with status filters — built to practice controlled components, derived state, and the useEffect lifecycle.

projects.title: Disney+ Hotstar Clone
projects.description: A Disney+ Hotstar frontend clone built with React and Firebase. Replicates the streaming platform's UI including hero banners, content carousels, and category rows. Firebase handles authentication and real-time data.

projects.title: Blog Post
projects.description: A full-stack blogging platform built with React and Appwrite. Users can create, publish, and read blog posts with rich text editing, authentication, and persistent storage — a practical introduction to BaaS architecture.

projects.title: Food Recipe Finder
projects.description: A React recipe discovery app that searches an external food API by ingredient or dish name. Displays nutritional info, preparation steps, and ingredient lists — focused on API integration and responsive card layouts.

projects.title: Instagram Clone
projects.description: A full-stack Instagram-style social app built with React and Appwrite. Users can create accounts, upload posts, like, save, follow others, and browse a personalized feed — implementing a complete social media data model.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: A weather app that displays current temperature, humidity, wind speed, and forecasts for any city using a public weather API. Built with React — focused on async data fetching, error states, and clean data presentation.

projects.title: SUN DOWN Clone
projects.description: A creative agency website clone replicating the SunDown Studio design using HTML, CSS, JS, Locomotive Scroll, and GSAP. Showcases smooth parallax scrolling, pin-based scroll animations, and precise motion design.

projects.title: Oach Design Clone
projects.description: A Oach Design website clone built with React, GSAP, Locomotive Scroll, and Framer Motion. Demonstrates advanced scroll-triggered animations, smooth page transitions, and high-fidelity replication of a premium design studio site.

projects.title: Next.js Blog
projects.description: A Next.js blog app demonstrating server-side data fetching, dynamic routing, and API routes. Features post listing, individual article pages, like and save via localStorage — a practical introduction to the Next.js App Router.

projects.title: Next.js Feedback System
projects.description: A Next.js feedback platform where authenticated users submit app reviews with AI-powered suggestion prompts via Gemini AI. Explores Next.js authentication patterns, API routes, and integrating generative AI into a form workflow.

projects.title: Quiz Builder System
projects.description: A React quiz builder where users create custom quizzes and take existing ones with instant scoring. Features quiz creation flow, timed questions, answer tracking, and result summaries — a complete CRUD SPA with local state management.
